- **Choose your folders in Manager on TrueNAS and Docker (FL-1311):** a new TrueNAS install now needs one edit, the name of your pool, and a new Docker install needs none. You pick where photos, the database and backups go during setup, and Manager creates the folders for you. Installs you already have keep their folders.
- **Choose your folders in Manager on Unraid (FL-1308):** new Unraid installs pick their folders in Manager instead of in the template. External folders adds an existing photo folder to Frameleaf without editing the template.
- **Clearer Add a folder messages (FL-1308):** Add a folder now tells you whether Frameleaf can't see a folder or isn't allowed to open it.
- **Progress while scanning folders (FL-1309):** Frameleaf shows progress while it walks through a large library folder.
- **Back to where you were on Explore (FL-1312):** going back to Explore from a search now returns you to the same place on the page, even when the page takes a moment to fill in.
